semantic_join.name: coordinated multi-site transport
semantic_join.statement: The residual is not asking for more local rewriting, provenance mixing, or one-endpoint attachment. The common obstruction is that current constructors transport one verified equality through one context at a time (or combine independently derived equalities without preserving attachment). A successful extension must coordinate two or more linked substitutions/transformations inside a shared anchored context so that relational structure is transported jointly rather than as independent local edits.
necessary_properties: shared anchor: at least one output endpoint remains in an existing residual component or is verifier-equivalent to an anchored endpoint
multi-site coupling: one operator application changes at least two linked positions/subterms under a common context
joint provenance: the coupled edits are justified by replay-valid equalities derived from the original source law
non-factorability test: the useful effect should not be reproducible by the same bounded sequence of independent unary context lifts already exhausted
cut relevance: the jointly rewritten endpoint must introduce or align structure from the opposite residual side
forbidden_explanations: more runtime inside the same unary-context regime
selection among existing G1-G4 operator families

next_family_constraint: Generate a previously absent anchored synchronized multi-substitution / paired-context constructor satisfying the necessary properties above, then test frozen baseline, factorized-unary control, synchronized intervention, ablation, and source-distinct transfer.
claim_boundary: This K(rho) was induced from the accumulated real SAIR residual field before implementing the next operator family. It is a falsifiable specification, not a proof that the proposed family will close the theorem.
